# T08 IGES/BREP fixtures

Test-only inputs for `[cad-iges]`/`[cad-brep]`. They are generated by
`GenerateCadFixtures.cpp` from OCCT primitives constructed in that file; no
third-party model, texture, or CAD drawing is copied in. The fixtures therefore
carry the repository's own test-data terms (no separate upstream license).

| File | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| `part.igs` | Box with a through-hole, shape colour, millimetre global unit flag |
| `assembly.igs` | Shared box placed twice plus a coloured cylinder; occurrence transforms and two materials |
| `part.brep` | The same box-with-hole as an OCCT `CASCADE Topology` shape set |
| `compound.brep` | A compound of two solids translated 20 mm apart; world-bounds coverage |
| `truncated.igs` | A real IGES stream cut mid-record (admission must fail typed) |
| `malformed.brep` | A real `CASCADE Topology` header with a `TShapes 7` table and no records |

`GenerateCadFixtures.cpp` is a developer tool. It links OCCT readers/writers,
never product code, and is not part of any solution or shipped target. Driver
commands are recorded in `docs/0.7.0/progress/T08.md`. OCCT embeds a creation
timestamp, so regenerating does not reproduce the committed bytes exactly; the
committed files are durable artifacts.
